asked.item: Is there an approval link to send the client
How to hold one post back for edits

verdict.reason: The FAQ states there is no built-in approval-link feature in the web app and gives the Move to Drafts steps to pause a post for edits.

steps.text: Blotato does not have a built-in approval-link feature in the web app.
To hold a post back, create it and schedule it for a future time, then review it in Posts > Scheduled.
To pause a post for edits, open the three-dot menu and choose Move to Drafts, then publish or reschedule once you are satisfied.
